nodes.label: notes.md (project decisions, how-tos and status log)
Otter-Grader autograding
nodes.rationale: Chosen over nbgrader; a student's notebook is graded in an isolated container, never inside the backend (which can reach the database), and scores are stored in Postgres.

nodes.label: Grader service (isolated grading containers)
nodes.rationale: Only service besides the hub with the Docker socket; the backend never gets it. Each job runs in a throwaway container with no network, 2 GB, one CPU, five minutes. No database access; only the backend can reach it.

nodes.label: Notebooks, submissions and grades stored in Postgres
nodes.rationale: No assignments folder on the server, so backing up the database backs everything up.

nodes.label: Assignment folder named <title>-<id>
nodes.rationale: Deleting an assignment and re-uploading a corrected one under the same title never hands students the old file.

nodes.label: Request size limits (10 MB notebook, 20 MB submission, 1 MB other)
nodes.rationale: An upload is only read after the account is checked, so a non-teacher cannot push a big file at the server.

nodes.label: ./dev.sh --lan network mode
nodes.rationale: Plain http for trusted testers and test accounts only; new hub, OAuth and grader secrets on every start; site and notebooks share one address so it is not for a class.

nodes.label: dev.sh local dev launcher
nodes.rationale: Needs the CyberP conda env (alembic, uvicorn). Backend starts on 8003 and moves to the next free port; site and hub listen on 127.0.0.1 by default.

nodes.label: dev-tunnel.sh tunnel to iqsec.cs.utep.edu
nodes.rationale: On iqsec only SSH gets through the firewall, so dev.sh is shared through an SSH tunnel with LISTEN_ADDRESS=127.0.0.1.

nodes.label: CyberP conda environment
UTEP server deployment (git pull, docker compose up --build, migrations)
nodes.rationale: Steps live in deploy/README.md; APP_ORIGIN must match the address users type; site and hub must share a parent domain.

nodes.label: Lessons as a list of blocks (Markdown, not WYSIWYG)
nodes.rationale: Blocks (text, code, callout, picture, video, notebook link, multiple choice, short answer) stored as JSON in Postgres with their pictures; text is Markdown as in notebook cells. Videos are YouTube-only (cookie-less); pictures are uploaded, never hot-linked.

nodes.label: Lesson working copy vs published copy
nodes.rationale: Students never see half-typed edits; 'Publish changes' hands over the new version.

nodes.label: Knowledge checks (server-checked, three tries, practice only)
nodes.rationale: Never reach the gradebook; students are never sent the answers before a question is closed.

nodes.label: No phone layout: iPad and desktop only
Settings menu for teachers and admins (superseded)
nodes.rationale: The menu only hides links; every section's data comes from the API, which checks admin/teacher flags from the database on every request.

nodes.label: Top bar Home / Teach / Admin areas
nodes.rationale: Replaces the 2026-10-02 decision to keep teaching inside Settings; old /settings links redirect via next.config.ts.

nodes.label: Brand: navy bar with cyan accent
nodes.rationale: Not UTEP's orange, and the UTEP name is not written in the site.

nodes.label: Admin rights given from the site
nodes.rationale: Replaces command-line-only admin rights. Acting admin re-types their password; students never made admins; nobody removes their own rights; rows are locked so two admins revoking each other cannot leave zero admins.

nodes.label: Admins reset other admins' passwords
nodes.rationale: Asks for your own password first so a browser left logged in, or a login hijacked through a student notebook in --lan mode, cannot lock other admins out.

nodes.label: Shared re-authentication guess limit (auth.REAUTH)
nodes.rationale: A stolen admin session gets 5 guesses in all per 15 minutes, not 5 per page. Any new password also stops the account's notebook servers and hub login.

nodes.label: Login lockout (5 wrong passwords, 15-minute wait)
nodes.rationale: Counters live in backend memory, so restarting the backend clears them.

nodes.label: Argon2 password hashing and HttpOnly session cookie
Same-origin check on state-changing requests
nodes.rationale: Requests from any other address, including the hub where student notebook code runs, get 403.

nodes.label: APP_ORIGIN setting
nodes.rationale: Must be exactly the address people type; the backend compares the origin exactly, so DEV_HOST must be lowercase.

nodes.label: Login/logout also ends the JupyterHub session
nodes.rationale: The next person on a shared computer does not get the previous person's notebooks.

nodes.label: JupyterHub admin panel (s-<id> / t-<id> hub users)
nodes.rationale: Hub's own admin panel; up to three servers per user (default, cpu, gpu). Add Users creates hub-only users; Edit User changes are overwritten.

nodes.label: Server-generated passwords shown once
nodes.rationale: Only the hash is stored, so the password cannot be shown again.

nodes.label: app.manage command line (create-user, set-admin, set-password, list-users)
Otter Assign notebook format
nodes.rationale: Otter builds the students' version at upload and refuses the upload if the teacher's solutions fail their tests; the platform runs otter assign itself in the grader.

nodes.label: Question points check against score tampering
nodes.rationale: Otter runs student code next to the hidden tests, so code could sway its own score; the empty students' version is graded at upload to get real points, and results claiming other questions or points are flagged in the gradebook.

nodes.label: Gradebook (Progress and grades)
nodes.rationale: Opening a submission copies it into the teacher's notebook environment: read it, never run it; the autograder is the safe place to run student code.

nodes.label: Student submission flow and statuses
nodes.rationale: Submit takes the notebook as saved; resubmitting replaces the earlier submission and grade; late submissions are accepted and marked late.

nodes.label: Courses group students
nodes.rationale: An assignment or announcement given to a course reaches its students, including ones added later.

nodes.label: Styling on Refactoring UI scales (globals.css)
nodes.rationale: Spacing, type, weights, radius, shadows and role colours are scales; new values are not invented, the nearest step is used.

nodes.label: Lesson topic index from Markdown headings
Code colouring (lowlight + rehype-highlight)
Account themes (Standard, Halloween, Retro 95)
nodes.rationale: Saved per account (users.theme) and mirrored in a cyberai_theme cookie so the first paint is right.

nodes.label: Light or dark mode for every theme (users.color_mode)
nodes.rationale: Dark colours are written twice instead of using light-dark(), which needs iPadOS 17.5+; a test keeps the copies equal and checks contrast.

nodes.label: Tests never touch the platform database
nodes.rationale: Tests run on their own in-memory Postgres (port 5434); conftest stops if DATABASE_URL is the platform's, and fakes every hub call as down.

nodes.label: check.sh (ruff, pytest, tsc, ESLint)
Home calendar and due-date timeline
nodes.rationale: Today is worked out only in the browser because the server may be in another time zone; the column is kept quieter than the lists and fixed at 256 px.

nodes.label: Students have only a username (no real names)
nodes.rationale: The platform stores no real name for students; one rule refuses a student name on create and edit.

nodes.label: Made-up usernames (adjective + noun + digits)
nodes.rationale: Word lists avoid people, bodies, violence and double-meaning animals; joined pairs are checked against a blocked list; never reuses a taken name.

nodes.label: GPU notebooks turned off (GPU_NOTEBOOKS setting)
nodes.rationale: GPU assignments open in the CPU environment sharing the same home so files survive; the hub refuses GPU servers outright because teachers pass the GPU check through the teachers group.

nodes.label: CPU and memory limits in deploy/.env
nodes.rationale: Caps, not reservations; memory runs out first because idle kernels are not stopped.

nodes.label: Privilege review security fixes
nodes.rationale: New secrets on every dev.sh start, hub bound to localhost, teachers no longer JupyterHub admins (that role opened every notebook server to every teacher). Finding 3 needs a wildcard DNS name from UTEP IT.

nodes.label: Exporting students' progress and grades (.xlsx / CSV)
nodes.rationale: Teachers may export every student since they already see every gradebook; rows by username only; formula-looking CSV cells get a leading quote and are stored as text in Excel.

nodes.label: Lesson .zip export and import
nodes.rationale: Exports the working copy; imports are drafts, all or nothing in one transaction; linked autograded notebooks travel with solutions and hidden tests, so the file is for teachers only; 100 MB / 200 lessons limit.

nodes.label: Changing an assignment's notebook after upload
nodes.rationale: Allowed only until the first student opens it; the save locks the assignment row so no student gets the old file after a replace.

nodes.label: Picture questions (multiple choice / true-false with a picture)
nodes.rationale: Not a new block type: a multiple-choice question with an optional picture, so grading, tries and the gradebook rule are unchanged.

nodes.label: Assignment data files (datasets) copied per student
nodes.rationale: Copies never overwrite a student's files; at most 4 copies at once to protect backend memory; Otter's files: list carries data into grading, which has no network; 20 files / 50 MB per assignment.

nodes.label: Dialog focus fix (autoFocus ran before the dialog opened)
nodes.rationale: The browser focused the Close button, so a space typed into the field closed the dialog; contents now mount once the dialog is open.

nodes.label: Classroom address cyberai.local (idea, not built)
nodes.rationale: mDNS name needs no DNS server; plain http only since no certificate can be issued for .local, so use a classroom router, not campus Wi-Fi.
